source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact tab-separated Greek payload, retaining whitespace and variant markers.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves the repeated comfort language and its purpose.
key_decisions.before: who comforts us in all our affliction, so that we may be able to comfort people who are in any affliction, through the comfort with which we ourselves are comforted by God.
key_decisions.after: He comforts us in all our affliction so that we can comfort those in any affliction with the comfort we ourselves receive from God.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: who comforts us in all our affliction, so that we may be able to comfort those who are in any affliction, through the comfort with which we ourselves are comforted by God.

key_decisions.rationale: Names the actual severity and Asia without softening despair.
key_decisions.before: For we do not want you to be unaware, brothers and sisters, about the affliction that came to us in Asia, that we were weighed down beyond measure, beyond our strength, so that we despaired even of life.
key_decisions.after: Brothers and sisters, we do not want you to be unaware of the affliction we experienced in Asia. We were burdened far beyond our strength, so much that we despaired even of living.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For we do not want you to be unaware, brothers and sisters, about the affliction that came to us in Asia, that we were weighed down beyond measure, beyond our strength, so that we despaired even of life.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps the inward verdict, purpose, and resurrection ground.
key_decisions.before: Indeed, we ourselves had the sentence of death within ourselves, so that we might not trust in ourselves but in God who raises the dead,
key_decisions.after: Indeed, we felt within ourselves that we had received a sentence of death. This happened so that we would not trust in ourselves but in God, who raises the dead.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Indeed, we ourselves had the sentence of death within ourselves, so that we might not trust in ourselves but in God who raises the dead,

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps the community's prayer and many-person thanksgiving.
key_decisions.before: as you also help us by prayer, so that thanks may be given by many on our behalf for the gift granted to us through many.
key_decisions.after: as you also help us by your prayer, so that many may give thanks on our behalf for the gracious gift given to us through the prayers of many.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: as you also help us by prayer, so that thanks may be given by many on our behalf for the gift granted to us through many.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps Paul's plan and the second benefit.
key_decisions.before: And in this confidence I intended first to come to you, so that you might have a second grace,
key_decisions.after: Because I was confident of this, I intended to come to you first, so that you might receive grace a second time.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And in this confidence I intended first to come to you, so that you might have a second grace,

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps the rhetorical questions and doubled yes/no.
key_decisions.before: So, when I intended this, did I act with fickleness? Or what I plan, do I plan according to the flesh, so that with me it is “Yes, yes” and “No, no”?
key_decisions.after: When I intended this, was I being fickle? Or do I make my plans according to the flesh, so that with me it is both “Yes, yes” and “No, no”?
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Therefore, when I intended this, did I act with fickleness? Or what I plan, do I plan according to the flesh, so that with me it is “Yes, yes” and “No, no”?

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps seal, Spirit, heart, and commercial image.
key_decisions.before: who also sealed us and gave the Spirit in our hearts as a first pledge.
key_decisions.after: He also sealed us and gave the Spirit in our hearts as a down payment.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: who also sealed us and gave the Spirit in our hearts as a first pledge.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains the solemn oath and stated motive.
key_decisions.before: Yet I call God as witness against my soul, that it was to spare you that I did not come again to Corinth.
key_decisions.after: But I call God as witness against my own life: it was to spare you that I did not come again to Corinth.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: But I call God as witness against my soul, that it was to spare you that I did not come again to Corinth.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves the denial of domination and collaborative contrast.
key_decisions.before: Not that we lord it over your trust, but we are coworkers for your joy, for you stand firm in the faith.
key_decisions.after: Not that we rule over your faith; rather, we work with you for your joy, because you stand firm by faith.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Not that we lord it over your faith, but we are coworkers for your joy, for you stand firm in the faith.
